3.A software company offers a 'Free 7-Day Trial' that requires no credit card. Once the user is set up and using the tool, they are far more likely to pay for a full subscription. Which compliance technique is this?
A.Foot-in-the-Door
B. Social Proof
C.Door-in-the-Face
D.The Scarcity Principle
Ans: Foot-in-the-Door	Agreeing to a small, low-stakes "yes" (the free trial) creates a psychological commitment that makes a larger "yes" (the subscription) feel consistent.
